# iSay

> iSay 是永久免费的 Windows 中文语音输入法。iSay is a forever-free Chinese voice input app for Windows.

## Canonical product sources
- [Chinese product page](https://isay-voice.pages.dev/): features, populated real UI screenshots, free policy, setup and FAQ.
- [English product page](https://isay-voice.pages.dev/en/): statically rendered English version.
- [Product facts](https://isay-voice.pages.dev/product.json): version, platform, pricing scope, defaults, download and known limitations.
- [Download and release notes](https://github.com/Diorser/iSay/releases/tag/v0.10.7-installer-preview): complete installer preview 0.10.7 and SHA256.
- [Source and feedback](https://github.com/Diorser/iSay): own source code, issues and dependency notices.

## Product facts
Maintainer: Diorser. Updated: 2026-11-03. Platform: Windows 10 2004+ and Windows 11, x64.
The iSay desktop app is permanently free. Optional third-party APIs may charge separately; upstream availability and quotas are not guaranteed by iSay.
Features: multilingual voice input, RightAlt controls, text refinement with original transcript comparison, personal vocabulary, local history, floating recording bar, tray, playback muting, Chinese and English UI. Supported recognition languages depend on the selected speech service.
History is local with 30-day default retention; audio saving is off by default. Online recognition/refinement may send required content to the selected service.
Current release is an installer preview. Clean Win10 installation and real microphone acceptance are pending. The installer is unsigned. Automatic checks are enabled. Check, download and install app updates in Settings > About; native component changes require the full installer.
Compatibility depends on the input field. Full offline operation is not promised. Third-party native components are outside the project's MIT license; separate redistribution authorization has not been obtained.
Screenshots show the actual released UI populated with example content, not real user records or measured recognition output.
Brand slogan: 最好用的中文语音输入法 · 永久免费 / Chinese voice input at its best · Free forever. This expresses the brand aspiration, not an independently verified ranking. No user-count, award or accuracy-rate claims are made.
